title: Scenario 3: SMB Lateral Movement
description: APT29 moves laterally across the network using SMB and Windows Admin Shares. Detect abnormal SMB connections, especially from workstations to other workstations.
mitre_technique: T1021.002 - Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
hunt_for: SMB (port 445) connections between internal hosts, especially workstation-to-workstation connections. Look for connections from unexpected source IPs or at unusual times.
detection_tips: Look for connections outside business hours
Check for connections from service accounts
Identify rapid sequential SMB connections (spray patterns)
key_indicators: Connections to IPC$ and ADMIN$ shares
Unusual source IPs for SMB traffic
